definition_one_sentence: A customer account with at least one non-cancelled order during the 12 calendar months ending on the reporting date.
formula_or_rule: For each customer_id, require at least one fct_orders record with a known status other than cancelled and order_date between reporting_date minus 12 months and reporting_date, inclusive.
example: On 2026-11-25, a customer's shipped order dated 2026-03-10 qualifies. A cancelled order alone does not qualify.
notes_conflicts: Approved in the lab role-play. Sales keeps a separately named Recently active customer (6 months) metric, using the same eligibility rule with a 6-month window. dim_customers.last_order_date includes all statuses and is insufficient on its own.

definition_one_sentence: Order revenue in euros after recorded refunds and excluding VAT, with shipping fees included.
formula_or_rule: Per order, ROUND((gross_revenue_eur - refunded_eur) / 1.20, 2) at the 20% VAT rate used in the lab. Sum the per-order values for a report.
example: A EUR 120.00 order including shipping and VAT, with a EUR 24.00 refund, yields EUR 80.00 net revenue.
notes_conflicts: Approved in the lab role-play. Sales can track a separate amount after refunds including VAT for commissions. The current model uses recorded order totals.

definition_one_sentence: A previously purchasing customer account with no non-cancelled order during the 12 calendar months ending on the reporting date.
formula_or_rule: Require at least one dated non-cancelled order before the 12-month window and no dated non-cancelled order during that window, including the reporting date.
example: On 2026-11-25, an account whose last non-cancelled order was on 2025-08-15 meets the proposed rule.
notes_conflicts: Draft definition recorded on the lab date for owner review. Excludes accounts with no qualifying purchase history. The churn model owner should confirm the window.

definition_one_sentence: A registered ShopFast account identified by a distinct customer_id.
formula_or_rule: Count distinct customer_id values from stg_customers. Each account is counted once.
example: Two accounts sharing an email address count as two customer accounts.
notes_conflicts: Draft definition recorded on the lab date. The model tracks account identity and can associate multiple accounts with the same person.

definition_one_sentence: A ShopFast purchase record identified by one order_id that can contain multiple product lines and payment events.
formula_or_rule: Count distinct order_id values from stg_orders. Apply status filters separately for the metric being calculated.
example: An order containing three product lines counts as one order.
notes_conflicts: Draft definition recorded on the lab date. Cancelled orders remain records and are excluded from the active-customer calculation.
